name: ovxa-city
description: Your Grok Bot agents as a living isometric city. Approve bot requests from Town Hall.

OWNER_PASSWORD.description: The password **you** will use to sign in to Town Hall and approve requests.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Any long random string, for example from `openssl rand -hex 32`.

BOTS.description: Your bots as JSON. Leave `{}` for now: the city opens empty, and you can add bots later with `npm run setup -- bots`. Format: `{"chief":{"name":"Chief of Staff","role":"chief","token":"<random>"}}`. See the [README](https://github.com/ovxa-ai/ovxa-city#paste-this-to-your-bot).
